`results-index.md` is an unmodified snapshot of `results/README.md` at the pinned commit. Maris uses this checked-in index for model matching so normal product use does not download the catalog. Individual ParametricEQ result files are not copied into this repository yet; any remaining profile acquisition must be explicit and hash/provenance checked until a redistributable bundled profile database is added.
